<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$promote-todo-to-openspec</code></p>

Review a todo.txt file and propose approval-gated transformations into existing or new OpenSpec changes without assuming one-to-one mapping. Use when the user asks to promote todo.txt work into OpenSpec; do not use for general notes or implementation.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link promote-todo-to-openspec --scope user
arcantry skills link promote-todo-to-openspec --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link promote-todo-to-openspec --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Compatibility

Source kinds: `openspec`, `todo-txt`.

## Learning outcomes

- Classify todo.txt items before deciding whether they belong in OpenSpec.
- Propose zero-to-many and many-to-many transformations without losing operational or private work.

## Examples

### Review a mixed todo queue

**Prompt**

> Use $promote-todo-to-openspec to classify this todo.txt and propose separate transformations for my approval before changing files.

**Expected outcome**

Every item is accounted for while operational, unclear, private, and sensitive work remains outside shared specifications.

### Consolidate overlapping product intent

**Prompt**

> Use $promote-todo-to-openspec to map these overlapping todo.txt entries into existing or new OpenSpec changes without assuming one-to-one promotion.

**Expected outcome**

A coverage ledger presents merge, split, relocation, and preservation choices that can be accepted independently.
